message.content:
The illustration is the front cover of a magazine with a black background and red and white text. The title "TEMPO" is written in large red letters across the top, above the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". At the very top, two headlines appear in white text: "Regulasi Buruk Komunikasi Elektronik H.24" and "Di Ambang Resesi Ekonomi H.78". Below the main title is a red and white logo for "INVESTIGASI", followed by the larger white text "Yang Cuan dari Wabah PMK". A paragraph of white text beneath this title includes the phrase "H.36".

The main visual features a dark brown cow in the lower-left corner. A thick yellow rope is wrapped around its head and muzzle. A light blue surgical mask hangs from one side of the cow's face, looped around the rope. The cow's mouth is open, and it is exhaling a large, dense cloud of white droplets and particles that spreads across the right side of the image. The particles are of various sizes and create a textured, spray-like pattern against the black background. The cow’s eyes are closed, and its skin appears tense.

In the top-right corner, there is a barcode, a QR code, and publication details including the date "1-7 AGUSTUS 2022" and the price "RP 50.000".
